text: Week 7: first card produced by the pipeline, graded as a test before the public record.
Week 8: the public record begins. Tier names changed from betting vocabulary (Best Bet / Bet / Lean) to Strong / Moderate / Slight.
The website became a Cloudflare Pages project connected to GitHub: a commit to data/latest.js is the deployment.

Week 11: first clean end-to-end run. The scheduled job built the card, pushed it to GitHub (6:48 PM CT), the site deployed itself, and the ledger was saved to Drive (6:51 PM CT) with no hand on any step. The independent checker confirmed all three the next morning.
